title: Rank of Pólya Groups in Lecacheux Parametric Family of Quintic Fields
summary: In this article, we study the Pólya group of a new family of quintic fields, namely Lecacheux quintic fields. We show that the associated Pólya groups can be arbitrarily large elementary abelian \(5\)-groups. Using density arguments, we prove that for every positive integer $k$, the set of odd integers $s$ such that the $5-$rank of the Pólya group of the corresponding Lecacheux quintic field is at least $k$ has a positive density.
